title: Fixed Raised Back Stock and Parallel Pin Marbling Comb
description: One newly authored whole static marbling-comb-inspired hand tool. A single continuous warm wooden-look stock has a low broad rectangular underside and an integral raised central back profile. Nineteen complete long satin-metal-look pins are rooted separately into its front face, run parallel in one open row, and taper only at their finite blunt end caps. Real open gaps separate every pin. The whole original flat stock underside is the only ground sole; the pins remain raised in this fixed resting pose. All profiles and coordinates are newly drawn; no old hedge-trimmer comb plate, berry-scoop teeth, binding machine hooks, brush or other mesh fragment reused. One model zero scenes, three opaque PBR roles, metres and native Z up. Generic category appearance only, not a branded tool or exact production dimensions; no paint, tray, marbled pattern, actual dipping action, pattern quality, pin flex, durability, safety, handling, manufacture, rig or animation claim.
